title: Security Deposit Account Whole-Unit Cleaning Rate When Carpet or Paint Is Replaced
content:
**Standard.** The whole-unit cleaning charge on a Security Deposit Account is reckoned on the surfaces left in place.

- **Both.** When the account carries both a carpet replacement line and a paint line, the home is cleaned as the next smaller floor plan. The whole-unit cleaning charge is then the cleaning rate of that next smaller floor plan.
- **One of the two.** When the account carries a carpet replacement line or a paint line, but not both, the whole-unit cleaning charge is the average of the floor plan's cleaning rate and the next smaller floor plan's cleaning rate.
- **Neither.** When the account carries neither, the whole-unit cleaning charge is the floor plan's own cleaning rate.

Floor plans run from smallest to largest: Studio Residence, One-Bedroom Residence, One-Bedroom Den Residence, Two-Bedroom Residence, Three-Bedroom Residence, Penthouse Residence. The Studio Residence has no smaller plan and keeps its own rate.

**Records read.** Whether a carpet replacement line or a paint line is carried is read from the itemized move-out lines of the account, by charge category, in any room. The floor plan is read from the Apartment Home Lease.

## Rates by floor plan and surfaces replaced

| Floor plan | Own cleaning rate | Next smaller plan's rate | Carpet or paint replaced, not both (average) | Both carpet and paint replaced |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 125.00 | 125.00 (keeps its own) | 125.00 | 125.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 150.00 | 125.00 | 137.50 | 125.00 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 165.00 | 150.00 | 157.50 | 150.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 195.00 | 165.00 | 180.00 | 165.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 235.00 | 195.00 | 215.00 | 195.00 |
| Penthouse Residence | 295.00 | 235.00 | 265.00 | 235.00 |

All figures are USD. When neither surface is replaced, the own cleaning rate applies.

## Condition table

| Carpet replacement line on the account | Paint line on the account | Whole-unit cleaning charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the next smaller floor plan's rate |
| yes | no | the average of own and next smaller |
| no | yes | the average of own and next smaller |
| no | no | the floor plan's own rate |

**Hypothetical case.** A Three-Bedroom Residence account carries a paint line in the living room and no carpet replacement line. The whole-unit cleaning charge is the average of 235.00 and 195.00, which is 215.00 USD.
